name: Anime Fusion QoL
author: nickohlmeier
description: Quality-of-life pack: on-screen encounter odds, 5% minimum wild encounter chance, optional hiding of already-caught species from encounters, 1-coin item buy prices, max IVs/EVs on catch, and an evolution-requirements popup in the Pokedex.

settings.label: Encounter HUD
settings.description: Show encounterable species and odds on screen while walking around.

settings.label: Hide Caught Species
settings.description: Stop already-caught species from appearing as wild encounters.
